subject: PlaneGeometry
question:
The robot in the diagram has been programmed to move in a straight line and, if it meets a wall (shown by bold lines), to turn right by $90^{\circ}$ and then to continue straight on. If it cannot go straight or turn right it will stop. What will happen to this robot? <image1>
Choices:
A:It will stop at $\mathrm{P} 2$.
B:It will stop at P1.
C:It will stop at $\mathrm{T} 1$.
D:It will stop at $S 1$.
E:It will never stop.
